mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 63 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. Also, the International Space Station will be making a pass tonight starting at 7:40 PM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot, appearing low on the horizon.
Road maintenance is on the horizon as chip sealing begins September 23 on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, while the city continues to review development projects for the October 5 meeting.

It is a busy time in our area with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival happening today, the Dane County Farmers Market today, and Bike the Barns taking place tomorrow at Badger Prairie County Park.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where they apprehended a suspect after a shot was fired during the incident.
While Culver's is open until 10:30 PM, please be aware that they are currently undergoing a remodel and do not have a flavor of the day available today.
